import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Set the style
sns.set_palette("husl")

# 1. Pairplot-style scatter: Petal Length vs Petal Width
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax1.scatter(species_data['petal_length'], species_data['petal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Species', loc='upper left')
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    species_data = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax2.scatter(species_data['sepal_length'], species_data['sepal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend(title='Species', loc='upper right')
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 3. Box plot for all measurements
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
data_melted = df.melt(id_vars='species', var_name='measurement', value_name='value')
sns.boxplot(data=data_melted, x='measurement', y='value', hue='species', ax=ax3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Measurement Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Value (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Distribution of Measurements by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xticklabels(['Petal Length', 'Petal Width', 'Sepal Length', 'Sepal Width'], 
                     rotation=15, ha='right')
ax3.legend(title='Species', loc='upper left')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Violin plot for petal length
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='species', y='petal_length', ax=ax4, inner='box')
ax4.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset: Comprehensive Analysis of Flower Measurements', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
